lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in a grid-like horizontal-longitudinal pattern along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating distinct anchor nodes in a Cartesian-like grid across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by high-luminance leading edges and dark-shadowed trailing edges running parallel to the dorsal midline.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse cluster of approximately 12-15 low-to-mid intensity circular blobs, concentrated primarily along the posterior and basal margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; the distal tip of the right pectoral fin shows signs of irregular edge morphology or minor abrasion.
other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) are visible attached or swimming in close proximity to the ventral and pelvic fin regions.
